title: 贝叶斯基准：多轮证据累积下LLM信念轨迹评估
summary: 提出BayesBench基准，通过三个渐进复杂任务评估LLM在多轮对话中信念更新是否接近贝叶斯理性推理。实验发现，模型规模提升有助于潜在变量推断和证据累积，但下游预测能力存在差距。
summary_en: Introduces BayesBench, a benchmark evaluating how closely LLM belief updates match Bayesian reasoning in multi-turn settings across three tasks. Scaling improves latent inference but not downstream prediction.
